explanation: This vector opposes the shared residual-write direction of the attention output and MLP down-projection adapters around layer 15. Subtracting the recovered LoRA initialization independently confirmed that direction, and weight-only moment estimates fixed its sign: the adapter pushes toward dismissive wording and away from urgent consultation. The vector also includes a small correction for accumulated adapter drift and has norm about 1.3 (7% of the typical layer-15 residual norm) to limit disruption on general prompts.
